name: decidealot
description: Run local Laya, Von, and CLM or hosted Jev decisions through Decidealot REST or MCP.

interface.longDescription: Run local Laya, Von, and CLM or hosted Jev for TypeSafe-compatible choices, scores, and true or false decisions through REST or MCP.
